shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.coarse: Larger step — the largest the axis offers
shortcuts.held: Moves for as long as the key is held
shortcuts.stop: Stops at the current speed — XY, then Z
shortcuts.coarseSteps: XY {{xy, number}} mm · Z {{z, number}} mm
shortcuts.note: Change the step and the speed on the jog card. The keys do nothing while you are typing in a text field, or while there is no connection to the controller.

timing.note: After the key comes up the machine reacts in {{total}} ms — {{parts}} — and the distance above is that time plus braking. The server times its own clock while jogging, so the number describes this computer doing this work.

stage.fit: Fit the object in the frame
stage.clickDrivesOn: A click on the drawing travels straight away. Switch off to have a click only mark a point.
stage.clickDrivesOff: A click marks a point. Switch on to have a click travel straight away.
stage.goToPointNote: Lifts Z to the top of the range, then travels over the marked point (machine coordinates)

layers.noWcs: The controller has not reported an active coordinate system
layers.noEnvelope: The controller has not reported its travel range ($130–$132)

go.noPoint: Click on the drawing to mark a point
go.outside: The point lies outside the machine's travel
go.ready: Lifts Z to the top of the range, then travels over the marked point

note.noHoming: Homing is switched off ($22=0). Machine zero is wherever the controller was powered up, so the envelope is the right size in an unknown place.
note.noSoftLimits: Soft limits are switched off ($20=0). The envelope says how far the axes reach — nothing will stop a move beyond it.

connect.title: Connection
connect.noServer: No connection to the server, so there is nothing to list.
connect.noPorts: This computer has no serial ports.
connect.openFailed: The port would not open. Another program may be holding it, or it may have been unplugged since the list was made.
connect.alarm: The machine is in alarm. Opening the port resets Grbl, and with homing switched on ($22=1) it will not move until it has been homed or unlocked. The panel will not unlock it for you.
